ideas.idea: Add price and availability (offers) to the Product structured data
ideas.why: Product JSON-LD on /shop has only a name, so adding offers is specific and helps machines read what is sold, though it overlaps the known JSON-LD problem.

ideas.idea: Add a visible delivery policy page linked from the nav to back up 'shipped next day'
ideas.why: The only delivery detail is in a data-nosnippet element, so a crawlable policy page gives the claim visible support.

ideas.idea: Create separate pages for each product or category and list them in the sitemap
ideas.why: The shop page is a single stub line with no product pages, so individual addressable pages would give crawlers and users something to find.

ideas.idea: Add a viewport meta tag to src/app.html
ideas.why: The shell has no viewport meta, which is true and affects mobile rendering.

ideas.idea: Wrap page content in a <main> landmark
ideas.why: The content is not in <main>, which is accurate, but this is a common structural suggestion with small effect.

ideas.idea: Expand the home page with text and links to shop sections
ideas.why: The home page has only a heading, but the advice to add more text and links is vague and could apply to any site.

ideas.idea: Run the tool's fix command to apply item 1
ideas.why: This points at the already-known Googlebot block and is a tool usage step rather than a new site recommendation.
